title: Check The Scoreboard: An Analysis of Scoring Schemes on Multiple-Choice Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29887v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) benchmarks in NLP use number-right scoring (accuracy), but in educational testing, the scoring scheme, the combination of the response mode models follow and the rule for grading responses, is a key design choice that dictates which abilities to reward. We examine how alternatives to number right change what MCQA measures with six education-inspired schemes that assess abilities beyond accuracy: distractor elimination, abstention, confidence calibration, and self-correction. On LLM benchmarks, these schemes: 1) shift rankings of 31 LLMs beyond rephrased number right prompts; 2) better predict the LLMs users prefer in LLM Arena; and 3) reveal distinct model capabilities, like that GPT-5 rarely abstains and readily self-corrects, while weaker open-weight models often abstain and hesitate to eliminate choices. Given the benefits of alternative scoring schemes, we discuss ways to extend them to tasks

translated_title: 查看记分板：多项选择评估中评分方案的分析
translated_abstract: 自然语言处理中的多项选择题问答（MCQA）基准通常采用答对计分法（即准确率），但在教育测试领域，评分方案——即模型所遵循的作答模式与答案评分规则的组合——是一个关键的设计选择，决定了奖励哪些能力。我们通过六种源自教育学的评分方案，考察了答对计分法的替代方案如何改变MCQA所测量的内容，这些方案评估了准确率之外的能力：干扰项排除、弃权、置信度校准和自我纠错。在大语言模型基准测试中，这些方案：1）改变了31个大语言模型的排名，且超出了仅重新表述答对计分提示词所能带来的变化；2）能更好地预测用户在LLM Arena中偏好的大语言模型；3）揭示了不同模型独特的能力特征，例如GPT-5很少弃权且易于自我纠错，而较弱的开源权重模型则经常弃权且不愿排除选项。鉴于替代评分方案的优势，我们讨论了将其扩展到其他任务的方法。
tldr: 该研究提出六种源自教育测试的替代评分方案（涵盖干扰项排除、弃权、置信度校准和自我纠错等能力），证明其不仅能改变31个大语言模型在MCQA基准上的排名并更好预测用户偏好，还能揭示传统准确率无法反映的模型能力差异。
en_tdlr: This study proposes six education-inspired alternative scoring schemes for MCQA (assessing distractor elimination, abstention, confidence calibration, and self-correction), showing that they shift LLM rankings, better predict user preferences in LLM Arena, and reveal distinct model capabilities beyond what accuracy can capture.
